title: Shinonome Ena — Behind The Scenes At The Sports Festival〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Behind The Scenes At The Sports Festival（2★）

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: This concludes the Kamiyama High School Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I ended up watching the whole thing because it was so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I should probably say hi to Mizuki before I go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see. The blue team should be...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah, I was just about to go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, have you seen Mizuki?
I was hoping we could talk before I left.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, the blue cheer squad's still probably having a meeting, so they're probably all over there somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Okay, I'll go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I'm gonna go to my cheer squad's after party, so I won't need dinner tonight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(An after party...
Oh, does that mean Mizuki's cheer squad's gonna have one too?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They couldn't win the whole thing, but they at least got first in the cheering competition.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hmm... I thought I'd ask Mizuki if we could head home together if they didn't have much left to clean up...)

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Ah, what a wonderful feeling...
To actually be able to end my last high school cheering competition on such a high note! With this sensation in mind...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Next, I'll have to do my best during my university's cheering competitions!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
This isn't your last one?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'm glad I stuck around to watch...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. I don't want to interrupt them, so I'll just send a message for now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. We had our Sports Festival today. Oh, K, I really need to thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. Remember how I asked you for a song that could go with my storyboard? It was actually for a video we wanted to use for the cheering competition.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It was? Wait, K. Does that mean the video of the blue flame you were talking about was...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I believe so.
I remember seeing that on the storyboard.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So you went to school every day to get ready for the Sports Festival?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup. They even said that I get an attendance bonus for every day that I showed up.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. But even without all that stuff, it still ended up being really fun. All the events were great and everyone went nuts during the cheering competition!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh? You could've at least told me that you were investing so much time into it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You say that, but I'm guessing that you were totally uninterested until you actually saw it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <By the way, did you go to the after party?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Yeah, I did... Wait, why do you know about that?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Akito said his cheer squad was having one, so I figured that yours was as well, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<How was it...? Totally normal!
We all had a blast while eating barbeque beef♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, you didn't go to a diner?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. We're growing high schoolers. You gotta eat your fill after getting in a bunch of exercise, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Actually, we held back a little to make sure we didn't burn too big a hole in the Captain's wallet.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, are you under the impression that after parties only take place at diners...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh? No, nothing like that.
A barbeque place just seems so smelly and smoky is all...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I get what you mean. Just the thought of my clothes smelling funny would probably prevent me from actually having any fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was worried too, but I was too hungry to care at that point.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, I'm glad you had a good time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Especially since Mizuki genuinely seemed to have fun with everyone on the cheer squad.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was way too much fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Also, Enanan, you okay?
You had this really creepy smile on your face just now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <H-Hang on! You can't see my face on voice chat! Quit jerking me around like that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh...? Based on how you reacted just now, I'm guessing you know what I'm talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How are you two able to do this every night...?>
